metadata.name: Boris Johnson
metadata.description: UK prime minister combining Brexit sovereignty, free-trade advocacy and unionism with public-service commitments, emergency spending and a strong defence and technology agenda.
metadata.scope: Personal positions and governing conduct during 2019–2022. Coalition measures are attributed cautiously. Modern hypothetical policies are labelled inferred, not claimed as direct statements. Research cutoff 4 October 2026; later views do not overwrite a former governing period.
metadata.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
